authority_source.authenticity_note: This records the actual user directive. No external credential, personal signature, provider approval, or production authorization is inferred.

conditions: Build provider-neutral deployment engineering and prove it locally with synthetic data.
Do not select or mutate a paid hosting provider account.
Do not publish images, push source, change DNS, create cloud resources, or deploy externally.
Do not use production or provider credentials.
Keep live payment, refund, payout, notification, AI, and other provider lanes disabled.
Do not weaken existing tests or production fail-closed controls.
A separate explicit hosted-staging authorization is required once a target account and domain are in scope.
